description: Empirical statistics of the first 430 Nyx ensemble members (aligned with the evidential INR splits: train 0-149, calibration 200-399, test 400-429), computed in log10(density) space.
dtype: float32 little-endian, same C-order layout as source density.bin

files.corr_matrix.bin: 400x400 <f4, Pearson corr of anomaly fields (member - voxelwise mean)
files.ensemble_summary.json: scatter helpers: crosshair lines, cov, 90% ellipse

definitions.mad: median absolute deviation around voxel-wise median
definitions.entropy: Shannon entropy (nats) of 64-bin histogram over global log10 range
definitions.outlier_maha: Mahalanobis distance in (mean,std) plane; >2.146 = outside 90% Gaussian ellipse
definitions.outlier_struct: robust z-score of mean L2 distance to all other members
